name: kuaishou_magnetic_engine-mcp
display_name: 磁力引擎 Kuaishou Magnetic Engine MCP
description: 磁力引擎 Kuaishou Magnetic Engine (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Ev

platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_cl.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_cl.description: app_id returned when the 磁力引擎 MAPI developer application was approved (开发者平台 > 应用).

platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_cl.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_cl.description: The application's secret; sent as `secret` in the refresh call.

platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_re.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_re.description: refresh_token from 获取token (auth_code exchange after the advertiser authorised the app); valid 30 days and replaced on every refresh ('刷新后会生成新的 token，老的 access_token 和 refresh_token 将不可再使用'). Set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the rotated token survives restarts.

platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_ad.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_kuaishou_magnetic_engine_ad.description: 广告主 ID returned with the access token at authorisation; used by the probe, update_budget and pause_resume.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No profile call takes a POST/query form, so the probe lists one campaign of the configured advertiser (POST /rest/openapi/gw/dsp/campaign/list, page_size 1).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: 查询广告计划 (POST /rest/openapi/gw/dsp/campaign/list {advertiser_id, page, page_size}): campaign_id, campaign_name, put_status (1 投放中, 2 暂停, 3 删除), status (1 暂停, 3 超预算, 4 有效, 5 删除, 6 余额不足), day_budget (厘, 0 = 不限), campaign_type, bid_type, create_time, update_time. The numeric status codes and the budget in 厘 stay in raw. status is not sent (put_status_list/status are numeric codes).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: 广告计划数据 (POST /rest/openapi/v1/report/campaign_report {advertiser_id, start_date, end_date, campaign_ids?, temporal_granularity: DAILY, page_size ≤ 2000}): one row per campaign and day with stat_date, campaign_id, charge (花费, 元), show, photo_click, aclick, bclick, conversion metrics. Only the first 2000 rows are returned.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: 修改广告计划 (POST /rest/openapi/gw/dsp/campaign/update {advertiser_id, campaign_id, day_budget}) with daily_budget in 元 converted to 厘 (×1000); 0 means unlimited, otherwise ≥ 500 元, and a cut may not go below 120% of today's spend. Uses the configured advertiser_id. This spends money; currency is ignored (CNY).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: 修改广告计划状态 (POST /rest/openapi/v1/campaign/update/status {advertiser_id, campaign_id, put_status}) with pause → 2 (暂停) and resume → 1 (投放); 3 (删除) is never sent. Partial failures are listed in data.errors. Resuming restarts spend.
